name: Kyryll's World
description: Kyryll's World was a terrestrial planet located in the Kyryll's World system, a part of the Phelleem sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the sentient Pui-ui species, members of which communicated in the Pui-ui language and which was known to the wider galaxy by 671 BBY.
